question: The slogan, “Freedom is my birth right and I shall have it”, was raised by:
solution:
The correct answer is **__Bal Gangadhar Tilak.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bal Gangadhar Tilak raised the Slogan,'Freedom is my birth right and I shall have it'**
 
• Bal Gangadhar Tilak, commonly known as Lokamanya Tilak was a leader of the Indian independence movement.
 
• Tilak was also known as ‘Father of Indian Unrest.
 
• He belonged to the extremist faction.
 
• He published two papers – Kesari in Marathi and Mahratta in English.
 
• He was fearless in his criticism of the government in these papers.
